question_text: Explain how transfer learning and data cleaning can help develop a useful ML text classifier from a small task-specific dataset.
adaptation_rationale: Retains supported transfer/data quality subsets; does not introduce transformer attention, NLPembeddings or historical research requirements.
solution: Transfer learning reuses a model trained on a related larger task/dataset.; Its learned representations provide a starting point rather than learning everything from scratch.; Adapting it to the target task can reduce the amount of task-specific training required.; Cleaning removes incorrect, duplicate or mislabelled examples that distort learning.; The adapted model still needs evaluation on relevant data; transfer does not guarantee accuracy if the source and target differ substantially.
